description: Any public URL → clean readable markdown: the article/main content without nav, ads or boilerplate, plus title, author, date, word count and links. PDFs too. Fetches the page (redirects followed, public internet only), extracts the main content with Mozilla Readability and converts it to markdown. PDFs are converted to text. Use max_chars to bound the output. JavaScript-only pages return whatever the server sends (no headless browser). When to use: For a page's content; for its metadata only use web_meta; for uptime/redirects use http_probe. Price: $0.002 per call (10 free/day; after that a payment-required result lists x402 options). Errors: returns isError with a message for invalid input or an upstream failure (not charged).

include_links.description: keep hyperlinks (absolute) in the markdown and return a link list. Default false.

max_chars.description: Truncate the returned markdown to this many characters. Range 500-100000. Default 20000.

name: web_read
title: Read a web page (clean markdown)
